cohort: The study included 202 infants with a gestational age less than 37 weeks, comprising 30 SGA infants and 172 non-SGA infants.
finding: The study found an association between insufficient thrombopoietin (TPO) production and thrombocytopenia in small-for-gestational-age (SGA) infants.
